notes: The two gam particles take the two postposed also's; each stands in its own clause and distance from the particle is not evidence against it (rules 25 and 51).
The substantival article takes he that; brought the tidings is a light verb with its complement, headed on tidings, with the supplied the joining that expression (rules 41, 44 and 15).
The article on ha-elohim is fronted to the phrase's left edge, the ASV rendering the rectum anarthrously (rule 29).
